cases.rationale: Demo policy emits a candidate only when the ordered pressure, forced response and regain events resolve in one period with enough sampled frame coverage.
A completed pressured pass does not satisfy the configured forced-error response condition.
The pressing side must win the regain; an opponent-team regain is not evidence for this mechanism.
The sampled frame window must meet the demo policy coverage threshold around the pressure event.
A pressure label without an observed presser position cannot support the configured distance check.
The pressured response must follow the pressure arrival within the versioned ten-second demo window.
The ordered mechanism must remain within a single match period.
A repeated source event ID is malformed ordered input and must be rejected before detection.
